title: Martinez as supervisor and Louis DeMaine as director
summary: Henry explains that DeMaine directed the WPA band while Martinez supervised the playing of the parts.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Did Martinez stand up and conduct the band with the guitar? Or how did he do it?

Well, Martinez was more of a supervisor of the band. Louis DeMaine was the director. He actually directed the band. He actually directed the band. But Martinez supervised the playing of the music. If the parts didn't sound right, he'd come down and look them over and tell you what note he wanted playing. Because he was a professional piano player himself.
